text: Five jobs are hiding inside your cash register, and you're still doing every one by hand. One. Receipts. Snap a photo, and an accounting app logs the store, the date and the total for you. Two. Customer emails. An AI writing assistant drafts the reply. You check it, fix one line, and hit send. Three. Your menu sign. A free design tool turns your price list into a clean sign in a few minutes. Four. The weekly sales report. Many point of sale systems can email you a summary every Monday, so you stop adding up columns. Five. Sales tax. A free GST and HST calculator gives you the right rate for every province. Pick one job this week and hand it off. Send this to the shop owner still doing all five by hand.
